review_role: Fresh independent Sol xhigh plan reviewer

snapshot.disposition: Reviewed the stable 739-line file captured at review start. The stated line count differs, but the captured plan and baseline did not change. Approval does not extend to another hash.

authorization.validation_method: Read-only plan, evidence and source review; no implementation tests or training runs.

prior_review_dispositions.evidence: Plan lines 86-120 give F01-F17 mandatory owners, acceptance and ordering. Baseline B01-B13 are represented, including the separate S3 defects; B14 is assigned to Phase 5A. F11 still omits its actual checkpoint writer from the Phase 2 scope; see R2-01.

prior_review_dispositions.topic: Concrete trust, identity, payload and archive security criteria
prior_review_dispositions.evidence: Plan lines 31-35 and 374-401 require trusted-peer-only pickle handling, session identity negative tests, finite byte/chunk/buffer limits before unsafe parsing, bounded failure and buffer cleanup, and TAR/ZIP containment across Python 3.13/3.14. Datasource, socket and Nanochat ownership is assigned without an authentication or protocol rewrite.

prior_review_dispositions.topic: Real socket exchange, parameter changes and aggregation smoke criteria
prior_review_dispositions.evidence: Plan lines 237-256 require fresh actual synchronous entrypoints on both Python versions, comm_simulation=false, actual socket/processor/serialization exchange, independently trained parameter-changing clients, a sample-weighted reference from received updates, isolated resources, deadlines and child-process cleanup.

prior_review_dispositions.topic: Supported examples require executed validation and closure of internal defects
prior_review_dispositions.evidence: Plan lines 494-526 require executed meaningful bounded behavioral smokes and reviewed fixes with executed regressions for internal defects. Parsing/import-only results or external-blocker relabeling cannot satisfy supported-family acceptance.

Plan lines 70, 176-178 and 713-715 record root-confirmed GitHub app capabilities and reachable SSH origin as the available publication path; gh authentication is no longer a prerequisite. This review did not independently test remote writes.

additional_required_checks.evidence: 1A -> 1B -> 1C -> gate is feasible. Metadata/lock, entrypoint startup, and test/workflow/default-promotion responsibilities have explicit handoffs. Root narrows broad envelopes into bounded tasks and serializes shared files. A tiny nonempty-data, ordinary-model, default-step FedAvg smoke need not await the later confirmed-defect repairs.
Python 3.13 remains the minimum. Python 3.14 default promotion follows startup/runtime qualification and the Phase 1 gate; failure retains the 3.13 default with a named blocker.

Plan lines 432-446 require two real MLX models trained from a common baseline on their local data, changed parameters, real extracted updates, numerical sample-weighted aggregation/application, checkpoint prediction equivalence, transport round trips and F17 rejection regressions.
Larger MLX features remain approval-required roadmap work in section 11. Existing transport repairs preserve the contract, and authentication/protocol rewrites are excluded.

findings.topic: F11 omits the actual PORT checkpoint writer from its Phase 2 ownership
findings.description: F11 names only plato/servers/strategies/aggregation/port.py as its exact implementation scope and is mandatory in Phase 2B. The corresponding writer is examples/async/port/port_server.py:34-41: weights_aggregated() passes model_<round>.pth to trainer.save_model(). ComposableTrainer rejects that extension at plato/trainers/composable.py:302-305. Fixing the scoped reader alone leaves the real PORT round failing and cannot meet F11's save/load acceptance. Active example files otherwise belong to Phase 4A, after the Phase 2 gate.

baseline_evidence.detail: The confirmed defect and red/green acceptance explicitly include the real PORT weights_aggregated hook.
The actual writer constructs a .pth filename and calls trainer.save_model.
save_model rejects filenames that do not end in .safetensors.
The corresponding historical-model reader also constructs a .pth filename.
The real aggregation lifecycle invokes weights_aggregated.

findings.requested_change: Add an explicit, limited handoff of examples/async/port/port_server.py and its focused regression to the Phase 2 F11 task, alongside the strategy reader and F07 checkpoint-contract coordination. Require the regression to call the real weights_aggregated hook and then exercise historical-model retrieval/stale-update similarity with the numerical aggregation reference before F11 closes. No broader example or protocol rewrite is needed.

summary: One medium ownership/order gap remains for an already confirmed PORT defect. All other requested planning criteria are addressed; resolve R2-01 before approving implementation.
